properties.source_note: McIntosh’s Shop and the nearby Shop lettering face two compact marks south of the Kingsville road junction. Both labels retain the shared candidate group because the source does not uniquely assign either shop to one building.
properties.placement_note: The shared shop group remains northeast of the river bend and southeast of the historical road junction. Modern branch connections differ, so the group is an approximate source locality only. McIntosh’s Shop and Shop 123 cannot be uniquely assigned to the two candidate buildings.

properties.source_note: Tannery and P.O. lie west of the River Denys crossroads. The rounded western mark and two marks north of the road are nearby candidates for the services, without unique assignment. Both annotations share the source group, separate from the school marks south of the road.
properties.placement_note: The tannery/postal group remains at the eastern road approach east of the railway/main valley corridor, with the school candidates to the south. The modern crossroads and small watercourse positions differ. Keep the shared service group; no tannery building or current postal site is selected.

properties.placement_note: The school remains east of the main meandering river and north of the next southern tributary/road sequence.
